tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or completely replace one UTF-8 source, configuration, script, or text file under the task submission directory. The path is validated, while content is treated as opaque text and is never interpreted as a filesystem path. Parent directories are created automatically.

path.description: A real absolute path below the task submission directory, or a path relative to that directory.

content.description: The complete UTF-8 file content to write.

tools.name: run_background
tools.description: Start a long-running task with an exec-style argv vector and return immediately. Output is redirected to the requested task-local log file.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Inspect one managed background job, or list all managed jobs.

tools.name: job_log
tools.description: Read a bounded tail of one managed background job's log.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Stop one managed background job by job_id after identity validation.

tools.name: skip_subtask
tools.description: Temporarily defer a genuinely impossible subtask only after it has received at least three valid Check Agent rejections. Earlier calls leave it uncompleted.

tools.name: submit_subtask
tools.description: Submit one subtask to a fresh stateless Check Agent.

tools.name: final_submit
tools.description: Finish only when every subtask is completed or validly skipped and all required files and process gates are ready. Uncompleted tasks are always rejected. If skipped tasks remain, the first otherwise-valid call asks for confirmation and a later call confirms evaluation with skipped work.

function.name: skip_subtask
function.description: Legacy compatibility tool. Its rejection-count gate cannot normally be reached when subtask submissions are accepted directly.

function.name: submit_subtask
function.description: Submit the current subtask and mark it completed directly after protocol validation succeeds.

function.name: final_submit
function.description: Finish only when every subtask is completed or validly skipped and all hard gates pass. Uncompleted tasks are always rejected. If skipped tasks remain, the first otherwise-valid call asks for confirmation and a later call confirms evaluation with skipped work.
